meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Baner | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: Our New Sangvi head office is the nearest D-SAP JEE centre to Baner, across the Babasaheb Ambedkar Bridge. Kota faculty, evening classes from {{fact:batch.timings#start}}.

intro: For Baner, our nearest centre is the head office in New Sangvi, about {{commute:baner#km}} km away on the other side of the river.

sections.heading: The way from Baner

body.text: Take Pimple Nilakh Road and cross the Babasaheb Ambedkar Bridge. The New DP Road and the Aundh-Ravet Road bring you to Sangvi Phata, and the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road leads on to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.

body: Our Wakad branch is a longer trip from Baner, which is why we point Baner families to New Sangvi.

sections.heading: Between the hill and the river

body.text: Baner has Baner Hill and the Baner-Pashan Biodiversity Park on one side and the river on the other. New Sangvi is a short drive across that river.

body: The evening session comes after the school day, so a student from Baner can finish school, eat at home and then cross the river for {{fact:batch.timings#start}}.

body.text: Baner students can start the two-year programme once Class 10 is done, or take the one-year programme in Class 12.

questions.q: Do you have a centre in Baner itself?
questions.a: Not in Baner. The nearest is our [head office in New Sangvi](page:centre-sangvi-head-office), about {{commute:baner#km}} km away.

questions.q: Why New Sangvi and not Wakad?
questions.a: From Baner, New Sangvi is the shorter trip by road. JEE classes at both centres run at the same time.
